theme: The Denial Came First - Volume III
title: The Timeline That Wasn’t
hook: Six months. One calendar. Zero names.

scenes.text: 30 December: I’ve asked for an investigation. We’ll be in touch.
19 January: Technical position unchanged. Legal is looking at it. No deadline. You can also use FalaBR.
May arrives. The same position. Who decided the lack of jurisdiction? Still not named. The calendar moved. The decision-maker did not.
